import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class MaxFlowSolver {
    static final int N = 15;
    static final int MAX_VERTICES = 2 * N * N + 2;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static class Edge {
        int v, next, cap;
        Edge(int v, int next, int cap) {
            this.v = v;
            this.next = next;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static int[] head = new int[MAX_VERTICES];
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static int total;
    static int[] current = new int[MAX_VERTICES];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAX_VERTICES];

    static int n, T;
    static char[][] grid = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] capsule = new char[N][N];
    static int[][] Z = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] S = new int[N][N];
    static int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static int s_node, t_node;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        edges.add(new Edge(v, head[u], cap));
        head[u] = edges.size() - 1;
        edges.add(new Edge(u, head[v], 0));
        head[v] = edges.size() - 1;
    }

    static void init() {
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        edges.clear();
        total = 0;
    }

    static boolean inside(int i, int j) {
        return i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n;
    }

    static boolean isDigit(char ch) {
        return ch >= '1' && ch <= '9';
    }

    static void run_bfs(int x, int y, int[][] dist_map, boolean mark) {
        int start_x = x, start_y = y;
        for (int[] row : dist_map) {
            Arrays.fill(row, 0x3f3f3f3f);
        }
        dist_map[x][y] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(x);
        q.offer(y);
        if (mark && isDigit(capsule[x][y])) {
            addEdge(start_x * n + start_y, start_x * n + start_y + n * n, INF);
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            x = q.poll();
            y = q.poll();
            if (dist_map[x][y] == T) break;
            for (int o = 0; o < 4; o++) {
                int xx = x + dx[o], yy = y + dy[o];
                if (inside(xx, yy) && dist_map[xx][yy] == 0x3f3f3f3f && capsule[xx][yy] != 'Y') {
                    if (Z[xx][yy] > dist_map[x][y] + 1 || (Z[xx][yy] == dist_map[x][y] + 1 && isDigit(capsule[xx][yy]))) {
                        dist_map[xx][yy] = dist_map[x][y] + 1;
                        if (mark && isDigit(capsule[xx][yy])) {
                            addEdge(start_x * n + start_y, xx * n + yy + n * n, INF);
                        }
                        if (Z[xx][yy] > dist_map[x][y] + 1 || !mark) {
                            q.offer(xx);
                            q.offer(yy);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int total_flow = 0;
        while (build_bfs(s, t)) {
            total_flow += send_flow(s, INF);
        }
        return total_flow;
    }

    static boolean build_bfs(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        System.arraycopy(head, 0, current, 0, head.length);
        dist[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).next) {
                int v = edges.get(i).v;
                if (dist[v] == -1 && edges.get(i).cap > 0) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] != -1;
    }

    static int send_flow(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == t_node) return flow;
        int total_flow = 0;
        for (int i = current[u]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).next) {
            int v = edges.get(i).v;
            if (dist[v] == dist[u] + 1 && edges.get(i).cap > 0) {
                int pushed = send_flow(v, Math.min(flow - total_flow, edges.get(i).cap));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    edges.get(i).cap -= pushed;
                    edges.get(i ^ 1).cap += pushed;
                    total_flow += pushed;
                    if (total_flow == flow) break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (total_flow == 0) dist[u] = -1;
        return total_flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        init();

        int x = -1, y = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid[i] = line.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    x = i;
                    y = j;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            capsule[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }

        s_node = n * n * 2;
        t_node = s_node + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (isDigit(capsule[i][j])) {
                    addEdge(i * n + j + n * n, t_node, capsule[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        run_bfs(x, y, Z, false);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (isDigit(grid[i][j])) {
                    addEdge(s_node, i * n + j, grid[i][j] - '0');
                    run_bfs(i, j, S, true);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxFlow(s_node, t_node));
    }
}
